name: Strana zelených (Zelení)
notes: Czech green political party; proposed 3.5% super-wealth tax above 111 million CZK in May 2024.

name: Johanna Nejedlová
role: Lídryně kandidátky Zelených do EP, výkonná ředitelka organizace Konsent
notes: Lead candidate for Zelení in 2024 EP elections; campaigner and director of Konsent.

name: Sociální demokracie (SOCDEM)
notes: Czech center-left party (formerly ČSSD); included 1% annual net wealth tax above 100m CZK in official program.

name: Jana Maláčová
role: Předsedkyně SOCDEM, bývalá ministryně práce a sociálních věcí
notes: Chair of SOCDEM since October 2024; Minister of Labour and Social Affairs 2018–2021.

name: Vladimír Špidla
role: Bývalý předseda vlády ČR a evropský komisař, ředitel Masarykovy demokratické akademie
notes: Prime Minister of the Czech Republic 2002–2004, European Commissioner 2004–2010.

name: Markéta Gregorová
notes: Member of the European Parliament for the Czech Pirate Party since 2019; re-elected in 2024.

name: Marcel Kolaja
role: Bývalý místopředseda a kvestor Evropského parlamentu (Piráti)
notes: Member of the European Parliament 2019–2024 (Vice-President 2019–2022, Quaestor 2022–2024).

name: Mikuláš Peksa
notes: Member of the European Parliament 2019–2024; former MP in Poslanecká sněmovna 2017–2019.

name: Miroslav Palanský
role: Ekonom, Univerzita Karlova a Tax Justice Network
notes: Senior researcher at Tax Justice Network and researcher at Charles University; author of the 2024 study on super-wealth taxation in Czechia.

name: Ilona Švihlíková
role: Ekonomka, prorektorka Vysoké školy obchodní v Praze
notes: Czech heterodox economist, vice-rector of the University of Business in Prague.

name: ČMKOS (Českomoravská konfederace odborových svazů)
notes: Czech-Moravian Confederation of Trade Unions; largest trade union confederation in Czechia.

name: Mikuláš Splítek
role: Portfolio manažer, Erste Asset Management ČR
notes: Portfolio manager at Erste Asset Management ČR and author of investment books; published column in Hospodářské noviny advocating progressive wealth taxation.

name: Budoucnost
notes: Czech progressive political movement founded in 2020; manifesto explicitly advocates taxation of extreme wealth and capital to relieve labor taxation.

name: Levice
notes: Czech democratic socialist political party formed in 2020 from the merger of SDS and Skutečná levice; program calls for shifting taxation from labor to capital and large wealth.

name: Gabriela Svárovská
role: Poslankyně Poslanecké sněmovny PČR, spolupředsedkyně Strany zelených
notes: Sitting Member of the Chamber of Deputies (Poslanecká sněmovna) since October 2025; Co-chair of Strana zelených since November 2024.

name: Matěj Pomahač
notes: Co-chair of Strana zelených elected in November 2024; author of analysis on wealth inequality and democratic institutions.

name: Kamila Fialová
role: Ekonomka, výzkumná pracovnice Sociologického ústavu AV ČR
notes: Labor and macroeconomist at the Institute of Sociology of the Czech Academy of Sciences; endorsed Gabriel Zucman's billionaire minimum tax / coordinated top-up wealth tax as relevant and feasible for Czechia.
